fusions.name: Swallowed Whole
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Your tongue takes the first enemy in its path up to 4 tiles away, dealing 24 damage, and you heal for 40% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Glutton's Belch
fusions.desc: Belches 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything in the cone and knocking it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Second Helping
fusions.desc: Increases your maximum health by 20% for 15 seconds, and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Six Courses
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per stack (18% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
